demo_scenarios.title: Frustration with Technology
demo_scenarios.originalText: This computer is broken and I can't do my work and I'm going to be late and everything is ruined!
demo_scenarios.description: High emotional intensity communication about technical difficulties

demo_scenarios.title: Social Invitation Confusion
demo_scenarios.originalText: I don't understand if you want me to come to the party or not. You said maybe but I need to know for sure.

demo_scenarios.title: Workplace Communication
demo_scenarios.originalText: Hey, could you maybe take a look at this when you get a chance? No rush, but it would be great if you could help out.
demo_scenarios.description: Indirect NT communication that might be unclear

demo_scenarios.title: Sensory Overload
demo_scenarios.originalText: The lights are too bright and the noise is too loud and I can't think and I need to leave now.

demo_scenarios.title: Routine Change
demo_scenarios.originalText: You changed the schedule without telling me and now I don't know what to do and I'm confused and upset.

demo_scenarios.title: Emotional Support Request
demo_scenarios.originalText: I'm feeling really down today and could use some support. Would you be able to talk or just be around?

demo_scenarios.title: Task Instructions
demo_scenarios.originalText: Can you handle the presentation tomorrow? It's pretty important for the team meeting.

demo_scenarios.title: Social Boundaries
demo_scenarios.originalText: I need you to stop asking me questions about my personal life. It makes me uncomfortable and I don't want to talk about it.

direct.original: I need help with this problem.
direct.adjusted: I need immediate assistance with this technical issue. Please help me resolve it as soon as possible.

gentle.original: I need help with this problem.
gentle.adjusted: I would appreciate some guidance with this issue when you have a moment. Thank you for your help.

empathetic.original: I need help with this problem.
empathetic.adjusted: I'm struggling with this issue and would really value your support. I know you're busy, but your help would mean a lot to me.

emotion_intensity_examples.text: I'm a bit concerned about this situation.
I'm really worried and stressed about this.
I'm extremely upset and overwhelmed and I can't handle this!
emotion_intensity_examples.description: Very high emotional intensity - crisis state
